text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After an outing, Yamanin Zephyr told
me she
wanted to walk some more, so
we've made our
way to the forest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight is glistening through the
swaying
branches... Such an elegant air.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What an awful blockage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr's voice hardens. I look
around to
see plastic bags and empty
cans strewn about
under the trees.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This clog was not the wind's doing...
Someone
must have littered here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do just that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We get some garbage bags and start
cleaning up the forest. The trash seems
to be concentrated in
one area, so it
shouldn't take long to tidy up.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Cans... Plastic packaging...
The soil can't
make
use of any of this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This will surely disrupt the whirling
winds
of the
ecosystem...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's an angry tone to Yamanin
Zephyr's voice. Knowing how deeply she
loves nature, I can
imagine how she
feels.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The least we can do is to clean up all
that we—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Oh no... Your hand's bleeding.
It looks
like you cut it on one of the can
lids.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Be still. I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, she comes back right
away,
carrying some grass and leaves
with her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
These are medicinal herbs. When I was a
child, I
used these whenever I got hurt in
the forest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr rips up some of the
herbs, then positions them so their oils
drip onto my cut. She
then places an
oval-shaped leaf on top of it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There... That'll be good as a gust in no
time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The forest is a place of both blessings
and perils.
As we've seen today, injuries
do happen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you've come to the forest with
me
regardless, and even helped keep it
clean and
safe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing these things because I want to
know more about her, and because I
want to cherish the natural world she
loves so much. But before I can explain
any of that...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But ultimately... your reasons are but
petals in the
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of where your actions come
from, they are appreciated. You love
nature too, and that
alone brings me
comfort.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A roseate current and a radiant breeze
are
blowing my way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So, please... Don't let today's events
besmirch
your opinion of the forest...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe... What a fresh breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind you bring is always so gentle.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
While I would love to stand and be
soothed by that comforting breeze
indefinitely... the wind is
beginning to
turn scarlet, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
While I would love to stand and be
soothed by that comforting breeze
indefinitely... the wind is
beginning to
turn scarlet, isn't it?
choice_data_list: ...Shall we get back to picking up...
Be careful not to get injured eith...
Be careful not to get injured, too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There isn't much left to collect.
Let's finish
up and make room for an
auspicious updraft to
blow through.
choice_data_list: ...Shall we get back to picking up...
Be careful not to get injured eith...
Be careful not to get injured, too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a sudden burster blows by,
everything turns
inexplicably white!
What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's a plastic bag on your face... This
trash has
made for quite the squall,
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing each other's faces, Yamanin
Zephyr and I
can't help but laugh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... Let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Fa-lalaaa. ♪ Lalaaa. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. You're like a nightingale
complimenting a
robin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Aren't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr smiles at me. We hum
together
and enjoy a short break.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to this sort of thing, so I'll be
okay. Oh,
mind that slope ahead,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you take small steps and drag your
feet a little,
you should be able to get
down safely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's very good.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this feels like something of a role
reversal.
It's as if I'm the trainer today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Yamanin Zephyr apparently enjoying
leading me along, we continue
through the forest and ultimately make
it back to the academy safe
and sound.
